terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A folding table shipped LOCKED OPEN: the legs fold in a real one, but the kit's entry describes the open silhouette and a folded-flat table would be a different prop, so nothing here articulates -- one root pivot, zero sockets. Set out by the dozen at any temple fair or market, so the draw-call ceiling is the design constraint. Every temple fair, market stall and school event; white laminate scuffed grey at the edges, an aluminium trim with two extruded grooves, dark grey square-tube legs with rubber feet.

reasoning: TWO components on TWO materials: the laminate TOP (one box) and the steel FRAME (four trim rails with their grooves, two apron rails, six hinge blocks, four X-legs, two struts and four feet merged). Two draw calls of two.

Two materials because a satin laminate at 0.38 and a painted steel tube at 0.50 / 0.20 do not share a response; both WHITE with the tones as vertex colours, the laminate carrying a faint scuff canvas.
No repetition system at two draw calls: four legs are four rotated boxes in the frame merge.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one declared box collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is a long thin white board on two X-frames -- the top overhanging the legs by 0.094 W at each end, the X crossing at 0.44 H, and the short strut that holds it open. A four-post table or a folded-flat one would be different props.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

resolvedUnknowns: The X-frames stand in the END planes, not the long planes: the proxy holds the leg x columns constant in every row while the z range narrows to a point, which is the signature of an X seen end-on.
One strut per end, on the +z leg: the proxy shows the diagonal in x at both ends; which leg of the pair it lands on is not resolvable from either source.

Legs and trim are LIFTED in tone (legs to luma 123 against the plate's 45-98, trim to 168 against 93-107) because a back-lit satin face renders at ~0.55 of its painted value and the turntable gate reads the backdrop's luma 58 +-24 as background; at the first authoring (trim 138, legs 100) the trim probed 64 at azimuth 180.
The declared size was corrected 1.80 x 0.75 -> 1.56 x 0.67 on the proxy before building (arithmetic in envelopeDerivation).
preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 1.56 x 0.75 x 0.67 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=2000 triangles, <=2 draw calls, <=2 materials, <=4 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

pivotInventory.justification: The rigid body of the prop at its declared origin. A named pivot is a promise that a part turns on it, and only real mechanisms get one.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this prop and nothing is emitted from it. A marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.

colliderInventory.note: Declared on the asset as box: the table envelope. The shipped compound is DERIVED from the geometry by scripts/derive-colliders.mjs.

actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

coordinateFrame.notes: Origin base-center at ground, +Y up, +Z the FRONT face (the face the plate shows).

silhouette.description: A 1.56 x 0.03 x 0.67 board at 0.720-0.750 in a 0.042-tall aluminium trim, on two X-frames of 25 mm square tube standing in the end planes 0.633 from centre, feet 0.52 m apart and heads 0.41 m apart, crossing at 0.33 m, each held by a strut from under the board 0.33 W in down to the frame at 0.555 m.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x +-0.791 at the trim, y 0 to 0.752 at the trim top (2 mm proud of the laminate), z +-0.346 at the trim. The LIST-TIME declaration was 1.80 x 0.75 x 0.75 (w/h 2.40, d/h 1.00). The Meshy proxy of the plate measures bbox 1.902 x 0.913 x 0.817, w/h 2.084 and d/h 0.895. Height is the trustworthy axis for a table (0.72-0.75 m dining height), so length = 0.75 x 2.084 = 1.563 -> 1.56 m and depth = 0.75 x 0.895 = 0.671 -> 0.67 m -- the 150 x 60-class Thai folding table rather than the 6-foot one; the declaration was corrected before building. Stations off the proxy: top rows 0.92-0.98 with 0.94/0.96 hollow inside (a board in a wraparound trim, 0.045 m for both); legs at columns 7-8 and 71-72 in every row from 0.00 to 0.90, i.e. 0.094 W in from each end and standing in a vertical END plane; the per-row z range narrowing from 0.10-0.79 H at the floor to 0.41-0.49 H at 0.44 H and opening to 0.18-0.72 H under the board -- an X in the end plane crossing at 0.44 H, feet 0.52 m apart, heads 0.41 m apart; and a diagonal from column 17 at 0.90 H out to column 9 at 0.74 H at each end, the folding strut. The plate shows the same X and strut.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate: bbox 1.902 x 0.913 x 0.817, w/h 2.084 and d/h 0.895, which corrected the declared 1.80 x 0.75 to 1.56 x 0.67. It also settled the leg geometry -- an X in the END plane with a strut, read from the per-row z range narrowing to a point at 0.44 H -- where the plate's three-quarter view could have been read as splayed straight legs.

viewEvidence.note: NOT OBSERVED. The underside -- how the legs hinge to the board -- is hidden; built as hinge blocks under the board at the leg heads and two apron rails, the standard folding-table frame.

pivot.name: root

componentTree.name: Aluminium edge trim and folding steel X-frames
componentTree.topologyRationale: Trim, grooves, aprons, hinge blocks, legs, struts and feet merged into one geometry on one material: one draw call.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Trim: four rails 0.014 thick and 0.042 tall around the board, top at 0.752. Legs: 25 mm square boxes 0.869 long rotated about x by +-33 degrees, from 8 mm above the floor to 10 mm into the board zone, the pair offset 26 mm in x; feet 31 mm pads; hinge blocks 50 mm under the heads; struts 18 mm square from under the board 0.33 W in to the +z leg at 0.555.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: Legs pass one another 26 mm apart at the crossing; heads run 10 mm up into the board zone and feet start 8 mm up inside the foot pads (a rotated box's end corner would otherwise dip 7 mm below the floor); grooves stand 0.5 mm proud of the trim face. check-coplanar clean at 0.001 m.

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: Every tone a vertex colour on one white metal material.

actionProfile.notes: Rigidly parented to the root. NO pivot and NO socket, deliberately: this part does not move and nothing attaches to it.

roughness.notes: Scalar observed for this surface in the plate. The independently extracted map is kept on disk as evidence and is NOT bound at runtime -- this material is textureless, so the scalar is the runtime value.

albedo.samplingNotes: Measured as the mean of crops/top-with-trim.png. extract_pbr_evidence confidence 0.860. The extractor palette is advisory only: these crops are flat material swatches, not isolated objects, so its foreground separation is weak by its own warnings. Albedo is the direct crop measurement.

localOverrides.region: the laminate top, heaviest toward the edges
localOverrides.evidence: crops/top-with-trim.png -- the plate's top reads 239-240 with faint grey scuffs at the near edge; carried as the 256 px scuff canvas (streaks and blotches, no ground wash).

evidence: Measured on the plate: top #f3eeea / #f0f0f0 (239-240), analyze_texture meanLum 239 sat 0.03 specularFraction 0.85 (a satin sheet under a soft key); extract_pbr_evidence on the flat-swatch crop scored 0.657 and on the top-with-trim crop 0.86 -- a flat white swatch gives the extractor nothing to separate, and the direct measurement is the albedo authority.
Textureless as DECLARED: one tone 0xf0ece7 as a vertex colour (probed 238 on beauty-000 against the plate's 239) and a faint 256 px scuff canvas after construction with no ground wash.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

evidence: Measured on the plate: legs #383639 / #2e2c30 shaded and #626165 lit (45-98), analyze_texture worn-composite roughness 0.9 on the shaded leg crop; trim #605c5e / #6c6a6a (93-107) with two extruded grooves; extract_pbr_evidence palette #29282A #262427 #2D2C2F #1E1D1E #7C7A7D at confidence 0.776.

Textureless as DECLARED: legs 0x7c7a80, trim 0xaaa8aa, grooves 0x6a686b, hinge blocks and aprons 0x5a585c, rubber feet 0x4e4c50, all vertex colours on one white material at 0.50 / 0.20. Metalness is capped because the harness binds no environment map.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. Bounds min y is 0.000 after the leg feet were started 8 mm up inside their pads (a rotated box's end corner had dipped 7 mm below the floor). Trim probed 77 at azimuth 180 after the tone lift, clear of the gate's band.
featureReviews.notes: Held back from higher by the strut's landing leg, which neither source resolves.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.88. 372/2000 triangles, 2/2 draw calls, 2/2 materials, 2/4 unique geometries, one canvas. Turntable with --allow-holes on the holeviz measurement: the enclosed background is the triangles between the X-legs under the board and under the strut, real openings.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the medium class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

materials.note: laminate and steel: 2 of 2; every tone within each is a vertex colour.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Boxes throughout: the board, four trim rails, eight groove lines, two aprons, six hinge blocks, four rotated legs, two doubly rotated struts, four feet.
No InstancedMesh at two draw calls. In a scene the HOST instances the table.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Both materials are declared textureless. One 256 px scuff canvas on the laminate after construction; the factory built in under 50 ms.

risks.description: The list-time 1.80 x 0.75 disagreed with the proxy by 15% in length and 12% in depth.
risks.mitigation: Corrected to 1.56 x 0.67 on the height axis before building; arithmetic on the asset notes and in envelopeDerivation.

risks.description: The X-frames and struts enclose real openings against the backdrop (holeviz: 11,149 px at azimuth 90/270 in the triangle between the legs under the board, 1,753 at 180 under the strut).
risks.mitigation: --allow-holes on the holeviz and _holecc measurements; the tones themselves clear the gate (trim probed 77 at azimuth 180 after the lift).

risks.description: Legs at the plate's 45-55 and trim at 93-107 render inside the gate's backdrop band on back-lit faces.
risks.mitigation: Lifted to 123 and 168; recorded as an assumption.
